label: Length burned in microgravity
reading: Burn length as written in the column "?-g Burn Length" of the Saffire-II table (first character unreadable in the PSI file). Cells written "~ 0" are read as 0. Two PMMA cells, "~ 10 cm (note 3)" and "~ 10 cm (note 4)", are read as 10 and carry the flag burn_length_cm:see_note_in_source; Note 3 of the table says "This is the length of fuel with significant visible damage." The cell "5 cm & 0 (note 2)" gives no value. The 15 cm criterion of NASA-STD-6001B Test 1 is defined for a 30 cm specimen in normal gravity without air flow; these tests were not run under that standard and are not judged against it.
